name: wedf_rw_edf_8
notes: q_wedf W2 (Tier-2): 4 reads + 4 writes interleaved in ONE async_batch, each class submitted sector-DESCENDING, read/write sector ranges disjoint and mutually non-adjacent (reads 2560-2752, writes 5120-5312, 64-sector gaps -> no merge). Phase-3 re-space (2026-09-01): original sectors 64-256/512-896 included partition-scan sectors 64/128/256/512 (insert_count=12 vs trace 8). Re-spaced above the scan zone (>2048): counts now structurally pure. Deadline rule (q_wedf.bpf.c:10-11, 47-51, 153-154): read dl = arrival+50ms, write dl = arrival+500ms. Cross-op deadline gap ~450ms >> 5ms window -> STRICT EDF: all reads dispatch before all writes; within each class deadlines sit inside the 5ms window -> SECTOR-ASCENDING (q_wedf.bpf.c:63). Expected ISSUE order: reads 2560,2624,2688,2752 then writes 5120,5184,5248,5312. Proves BOTH the 50/500ms EDF offset rule AND the within-window locality rule.
